README.md.content:
# Account app

JavaScript ESM, no dependencies. Product features live under src/features.
src/app.js composes their public entry points. Use named exports, camelCase names,
two-space indentation, single quotes and semicolons as in the existing sources.
Repositories are injected by the host.

Invoice repository: repositories.invoices.load(id) returns an invoice with
lines: [{quantity, unitPriceCents}]. Total is the sum of quantity times unit price,
in integer cents. Negative or noninteger quantities and prices are invalid.
